[[General/Legends|General]] '''Linel Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. Stationed in [[King's Pass]], he asked a Republic individual to re-purpose an observatory taken over by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] to spy on the forces of [[House Ulgo]].
